text: Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail, and Peter.
zh: 弗洛普西、莫普西、棉尾和彼得。

text: They lived with their Mother in a sand-bank, underneath the root of a very big fir-tree.
zh: 他们和母亲住在沙洲里，在一棵很大的枞树根下。

text: Now my dears,' said old Mrs. Rabbit one morning, 'you may go into the fields or down the lane, but don't go into Mr. McGregor's garden: your Father had an accident there; he was put in a pie by Mrs.
zh: 现在，亲爱的，一天早上，老兔太太说道，“你们可以到田野里去，或者沿着小路走，但不要去麦格雷戈先生的花园里：你们的父亲在那里出了事故；你们可以去麦格雷戈先生的花园里。”他被夫人放进了馅饼里。
chunks: Now my dears, ' said old Mrs. Rabbit one morning,
or down the lane, but don't go
into Mr. McGregor's garden: your Father had an accident there;
he was put in a pie by Mrs.

text: Now run along, and don't get into mischief.
Then old Mrs. Rabbit took a basket and her umbrella, and went through the wood to the baker's.
zh: 然后，老兔太太拿着篮子和雨伞，穿过树林来到面包店。
chunks: Then old Mrs. Rabbit took a basket

text: She bought a loaf of brown bread and five currant buns.
zh: 她买了一条黑面包和五个醋栗面包。
chunks: of brown bread and five currant buns.

text: But Peter, who was very naughty, ran straight away to Mr. McGregor's garden, and squeezed under the gate!
zh: 可是彼得非常调皮，径直跑到了麦格雷戈先生的花园里，从大门下面挤了过去！

text: And then, feeling rather sick, he went to look for some parsley.
zh: 然后，他感觉很不舒服，就去寻找一些欧芹。

text: But round the end of a cucumber frame, whom should he meet but Mr.
zh: 但在黄瓜架的尽头，除了先生之外，他应该遇见谁。

text: Peter was most dreadfully frightened; he rushed all over the garden, for he had forgotten the way back to the gate.
zh: 彼得非常害怕。他跑遍了整个花园，因为他忘记了返回大门的路。
chunks: for he had forgotten the way back

text: He lost one of his shoes among the cabbages, and the other shoe amongst the potatoes.
zh: 他的一只鞋子丢在卷心菜里，另一只鞋子丢在土豆里。
chunks: and the other shoe amongst the potatoes.

text: After losing them, he ran on four legs and went faster, so that I think he might have got away altogether if he had not unfortunately run into a gooseberry net, and got caught by the large buttons on his jacket.
chunks: After losing them, he ran on four legs and went faster,
so that I think he might have got away altogether
if he had not unfortunately run
into a gooseberry net, and got caught
by the large buttons on his jacket.

text: It was a blue jacket with brass buttons, quite new.
zh: 那是一件带有黄铜纽扣的蓝色夹克，很新。

text: Peter gave himself up for lost, and shed big tears; but his sobs were overheard by some friendly sparrows, who flew to him in great excitement, and implored him to exert himself.
zh: 彼得自暴自弃，流下了大滴的泪水。但他的抽泣被一些友好的麻雀听到，它们非常兴奋地飞到他身边，恳求他努力一下。
chunks: Peter gave himself up for lost,
and shed big tears; but his sobs were overheard
by some friendly sparrows, who flew to him
in great excitement, and implored him

text: Mr. McGregor came up with a sieve, which he intended to pop upon the top of Peter; but Peter wriggled out just in time, leaving his jacket behind him.
zh: 麦格雷戈先生拿出了一个筛子，他打算把它放在彼得的身上。但彼得及时扭动着出去，把他的夹克留在了身后。
chunks: Mr. McGregor came up with a sieve,
but Peter wriggled out just in time,

text: And rushed into the tool-shed, and jumped into a can.
zh: 冲进工具棚，跳进一个罐头里。

text: It would have been a beautiful thing to hide in, if it had not had so much water in it.
zh: 如果里面没有那么多水的话，藏在里面会是一件很漂亮的事情。
chunks: It would have been a beautiful thing

text: Mr. McGregor was quite sure that Peter was somewhere in the tool-shed, perhaps hidden underneath a flower-pot.
zh: 麦格雷戈先生非常确定彼得在工具棚的某个地方，也许藏在花盆下面。

text: He began to turn them over carefully, looking under each.
zh: 他开始小心翼翼地把它们翻过来，检查每一个的下面。

text: Mr. McGregor was after him in no time.
And tried to put his foot upon Peter, who jumped out of a window, upsetting three plants.
zh: 并试图用脚踩彼得，彼得跳出了窗外，掀翻了三棵植物。

text: The window was too small for Mr. McGregor, and he was tired of running after Peter.
zh: 窗户对麦格雷戈先生来说太小了，而且他厌倦了追赶彼得。

text: He went back to his work.
zh: 他又回去工作了。

text: Peter sat down to rest; he was out of breath and trembling with fright, and he had not the least idea which way to go.
zh: 彼得坐下来休息。他气喘吁吁，吓得浑身发抖，完全不知道该走哪条路。
chunks: Peter sat down to rest; he was
and he had not the least idea

text: Also he was very damp with sitting in that can.
zh: 而且他坐在那个罐子里也很湿。

text: After a time he began to wander about, going lippity--lippity--not very fast, and looking all round.
zh: 过了一会儿，他开始四处游荡，走得很慢——走得很慢，四处张望。

text: He found a door in a wall; but it was locked, and there was no room for a fat little rabbit to squeeze underneath.
zh: 他在墙上发现了一扇门；但它是锁着的，里面没有空间让一只胖乎乎的小兔子挤进去。
chunks: He found a door in a wall;

text: An old mouse was running in and out over the stone doorstep, carrying peas and beans to her family in the wood.
chunks: to her family in the wood.

text: Peter asked her the way to the gate, but she had such a large pea in her mouth that she could not answer.
zh: 彼得问她去大门的路，但她嘴里叼着一颗很大的豌豆，无法回答。
chunks: but she had such a large pea

text: She only shook her head at him.
zh: 她只是对他摇了摇头。

text: Then he tried to find his way straight across the garden, but he became more and more puzzled.
zh: 然后他试图找到直接穿过花园的路，但他变得越来越困惑。
chunks: to find his way straight across the garden,

text: Presently, he came to a pond where Mr.
zh: 不久，他来到了先生所在的一个池塘边。

text: A white cat was staring at some gold-fish, she sat very, very still, but now and then the tip of her tail twitched as if it were alive.
zh: 一只白猫正盯着一条金鱼，一动不动地坐着，但尾巴尖时不时地抽动一下，好像它是活的一样。
chunks: at some gold-fish, she sat very,
very still, but now and then the tip

text: Peter thought it best to go away without speaking to her; he had heard about cats from his cousin, little Benjamin Bunny.
zh: 彼得认为最好不跟她说话就走开。他从他的表弟小本杰明兔子那里听说过猫。
chunks: from his cousin, little Benjamin Bunny.

text: He went back towards the tool-shed, but suddenly, quite close to him, he heard the noise of a hoe--scr-r-ritch, scratch, scratch, scritch.
zh: 他朝工具棚走去，但突然，在离他很近的地方，他听到了锄头的声音——刮、刮、刮。
chunks: He went back towards the tool-shed,
of a hoe--scr-r-ritch, scratch, scratch, scritch.

text: Peter scuttered underneath the bushes.
But presently, as nothing happened, he came out, and climbed upon a wheelbarrow and peeped over.
zh: 但不久，什么也没发生，他就出来了，爬上一辆独轮车，向外张望。

text: The first thing he saw was Mr. McGregor hoeing onions.
zh: 他首先看到的是正在锄洋葱的麦格雷戈先生。

text: His back was turned towards Peter, and beyond him was the gate!
zh: 他背对着彼得，他身后就是大门！
chunks: and beyond him was the gate!

text: Peter got down very quietly off the wheelbarrow; and started running as fast as he could go, along a straight walk behind some black-currant bushes.
zh: 彼得悄悄地从独轮车上下来。他开始以最快的速度奔跑，沿着黑醋栗灌木丛后面的笔直小路奔跑。
chunks: Peter got down very quietly off the wheelbarrow;

text: Mr. McGregor caught sight of him at the corner, but Peter did not care.
zh: 麦格雷戈先生在拐角处看到了他，但彼得并不在意。

text: He slipped underneath the gate, and was safe at last in the wood outside the garden.
zh: 他从门下溜了进去，终于安全地躲到了花园外的树林里。

text: Mr. McGregor hung up the little jacket and the shoes for a scare-crow to frighten the blackbirds.
zh: 麦格雷戈先生把小夹克和鞋子挂起来，当成稻草人来吓唬乌鸫。
chunks: Mr. McGregor hung up the little jacket
and the shoes for a scare-crow to frighten the blackbirds.

text: Peter never stopped running or looked behind him till he got home to the big fir-tree.
chunks: or looked behind him till he got home to the big fir-tree.

text: He was so tired that he flopped down upon the nice soft sand on the floor of the rabbit-hole and shut his eyes.
zh: 他太累了，瘫倒在兔子洞地板上柔软的沙子上，闭上了眼睛。
chunks: on the floor of the rabbit-hole

text: His mother was busy cooking; she wondered what he had done with his clothes.
zh: 他的母亲正在忙着做饭。她想知道他对他的衣服做了什么。
chunks: she wondered what he had done

text: It was the second little jacket and pair of shoes that Peter had lost in a fortnight!
zh: 这是彼得在两周内丢失的第二件小夹克和一双鞋子！
chunks: It was the second little jacket
and pair of shoes that Peter had lost in a fortnight!

text: I am sorry to say that Peter was not very well during the evening.
zh: 我很遗憾地说，彼得晚上身体不太好。
chunks: to say that Peter was not very well during the evening.

text: His mother put him to bed, and made some camomile tea; and she gave a dose of it to Peter!
zh: 他的母亲让他上床睡觉，并泡了一些甘菊茶。她给了彼得一剂！

text: One table-spoonful to be taken at bed-time.
zh: 睡前服用一汤匙。

text: But Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail had bread and milk and blackberries for supper.
zh: 但弗洛普西、莫普西和棉尾晚饭吃的是面包、牛奶和黑莓。
